t: 格陵兰的努克市由皇家总督克赖斯·帕尔斯(Claus Paarss)建立为戈德特-哈布的要塞.
te: The city of Nuuk in Greenland is founded as the fort of Godt-Haab by the royal governor Claus Paarss.
